summary: Fathom Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it received Nasdaq notification confirming compliance with the bid price rule—closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days from June 19, 2026 through July 6, 2026, following a prior deficiency notice. The matter is now closed. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or fundamental corporate change is involved.
